pages.text: The Grid in Refined Storage 2 has been completely revamped to provide a unified interface for both items and fluids. This integration eliminates the need for separate fluid grids, offering a more streamlined and efficient way to manage all your resources. The new Grid features enhanced performance, better organization capabilities, and improved search functionality.

Key improvements:$(li)Unified item and fluid management$(li)Enhanced search capabilities$(li)Better sorting options$(li)Improved filter system$(li)Real-time updates$(li)Better mod compatibility$(li)Enhanced performance for large networks$(li)Improved resource visualization

Features:$(li)View all items and fluids in one interface$(li)Advanced search with new filters$(li)Sort by name, quantity, or mod$(li)Group similar items and fluids$(li)Customizable view settings$(li)Enhanced JEI/REI integration$(li)Better crafting integration$(li)Improved drag-and-drop support

Usage:$(li)Place within network range$(li)Connect to your network$(li)Right-click to open interface$(li)Use search bar for items/fluids$(li)Click to extract resources$(li)Shift-click for stack operations$(li)Use mouse wheel for quantity$(li)Configure view preferences
